what: In the middle of a background-colored curtain sits a multicolor petal logo — each petal starts pushed 15px outward from the logo center and transparent, then gathers in over .8s power2.out in random order (.04 stagger). After gathering, each petal keeps swaying ±2~5° over 3~6s (sine.inOut back and forth), and some swell 35~75% toward a circle and return (flubber shape interpolation, 2.8s + order × .15s). The whole logo turns once every 24s and breathes to 1.06 scale over 4s, while the wordmark floats up in 2s. fx:done fires at 2.4s, and .2s later the curtain lifts away over .8s.
needs: flubber (optional — without it only the petal swelling is missing)

options.hold: When the curtain starts lifting (ms), default 2400
options.spread: Distance the petals are initially offset (svg units), default 15
options.still: Petal sequence that doesn’t swell (comma-separated), default 1,6,11,16 — the original uses four colors
options.data-fx-part: mark (stone group g)·petal (petal path, multiple)·word (wordmark, optional)
options.fx:done: When the veil starts lifting — the hero entrance picks this up and fires 1.1s and 1.4s later

use: Brand
note: The original shows only on the first visit and is skipped when returning from another page (sessionStorage) — that decision is left to the consumer, who chooses whether to insert the element

from.where: shared.js first-visit loader (original runPreloader — 20 petals · SPREAD 15 · .8 power2.out .04 random · flubber t .35~.75 · 24s · 1.06 · 2400ms · .8s)
